newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar easier at close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar easier at close.

text.p: LIFFE white sugar futures continued to drift lower in the late afternoon in a slow pace of business.

In the absence of any fresh constructive news, the overhead resistance levels of just above $330 in October and $325 in December appeared to be exerting downward pressure on the market at present, traders said.
At the close values were between $1.30 and $0.20 a tonne down in the active months and turnover totalled 1,790 lots.
In Paris October 45 ICUMSA ended $0.50 down at $329.50 a tonne and turnover totalled 282 lots. 100 ICUMSA ended with October unchanged at $303.00 in a total turnover of 167 lots.
